text:
ops_oncall: heads up — getting multiple reports of 401s for API requests to hosted endpoints starting ~09:12 UTC. alert shows surge from auth-introspect failures. marking sev2, paging infra_sre and support_tier2

maria: seeing it too, large customer ticket at 09:15 complaining 'invalid_token' on everything. their token used to work. :frowning:

samir: quick check — auth-introspect logs show `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` and `failed to verify signature` around 09:10. looks like key validation errors, maybe JWKS mismatch.

dena: deploy-bot pushed a cert rotation earlier on the auth-introspect cluster at 09:05 — was scheduled rollout of new x509 for the introspection worker. did we also rotate the JWKS pub keys in the identity provider? @maria do you have rollout notes?

maria: i triggered the cert/key rotation for the introspect-worker via the deploy job: `deploy auth:introspect v2026.03.15-rot`. i updated the server cert but forgot to push the new JWKS to the idp mirror cache (we rely on the idp to publish keys). i thought the CDN would pick it up automatically.

support_tier2: reproducer from a client — curl to our API that calls introspect endpoint returns 401 and introspect returns 500-ish:

```
# reproduce
curl -s -X POST https://introspect.internal.redwood/v1/introspect -d '{"token":"<example>"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json" -i
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:14:21 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "introspection_failed",
  "detail": "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"
}
```

infra_sre: nginx upstream cache TTL for /.well-known/jwks.json is 300s on the edge CDN, but the internal jwks mirror has a stale file because the idp push step didn't invalidate. so some servers used old JWKS, others pulled new certs — signature validation fails intermittently. that explains why some requests succeed and many fail.

ops_oncall: immediate mitigation options?

samir: short-term: rollback to previous server cert (v2026.03.14) on introspect-workers to re-align with the previously-published JWKS. also force JWKS metadata refresh on the idp mirror and purge CDN caches.

dena: i'm doing rollback now — scaling down new pods and scaling up old revision. rolling update cmd: `kubectl set image deploy/auth-introspect auth-introspect=registry/redwood/auth-introspect:v2026.03.14`

deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-introspect -> v2026.03.14 (rollout id 8472). watch: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/8472

maria: i've contacted idp ops to publish the matching JWKS and invalidated the mirror cache. they confirmed push and gave me a publication event id: pub_20260315_0916.

support_tier2: still seeing errors for a subset — looks like some edge nodes haven't purged. tried `PURGE` to CDN on /.well-known/jwks.json, response 200 for most, but a couple of POPs returned 504.

infra_sre: i'm iterating POPs and forcing manual flushes. adding temporary header to force bypass: `Cache-Control: no-cache` on the introspect requests from workers until caches converge. also raising keepalive so retries backoff slower.

samir: note for postmortem — root cause is rollout ordering and stale JWKS mirror. the rollout replaced server certs before the idp mirror and CDN had the new public key. lack of atomic key swap + no fallback to previous JWKS caused signature verification to fail. need safe rotation runbook.

dena: rollback progress: 4/6 pods on old revision, expected full roll by 09:21. will monitor error rate on /v1/introspect and API 401 counts.

ops_oncall: customers updated: "we're aware and rolling back, ETA 10-15m, will follow up with incident postmortem". cc: support channel.

maria: drafting customer comms: short + technical blurb + ETA. will avoid blame wording.

support_tier2: tickets — adding note: reproduction steps + request for any recent client cert changes (none reported). also asked customers to retry after 10m.

infra_sre: rollback completed at 09:20. metrics show introspect 500s dropping to baseline, API 401s dropping too. some stragglers with increased latency while caches warm.

ops_oncall: setting incident -> postmortem. action items assigned:
- dena: update rotation runbook with atomic jwks + cert swap checklist + CDN invalidation steps (P1)
- samir: add graceful fallback in introspect: if JWKS verification fails, consult previous-key cache for 5 minutes before rejecting tokens (P2)
- maria: add CI gating to rotation job: ensure idp mirror accepts new JWKS before rolling server certs (P1)
- infra_sre: add monitoring alert for JWKS mismatch errors (x509 failures) (P2)

dena: also propose preflight check script: `scripts/check-jwks-sync.sh` that'll verify fingerprint match across idp and edge before rotation.

maria: assigning Sev2 -> incident channel doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1719004821 (tracking)

support_tier2: customers notified, some upgraded to high-priority tickets.

ops_oncall: closing realtime incident, leaving open for postmortem and follow-ups. thanks all for quick response. :white_check_mark:

samir: quick notes to include in PM: timestamps of cert push (09:05), JWKS publish (09:16), rollback start (09:17), rollback end (09:20), affected customers list attached in incident doc.

infra_sre: i'll follow up with CDN team to reduce TTL on jwks.json to 60s for future rotations and add a purge-on-rotate hook in the deployment pipeline.

maria: postmortem doc will also include suggested templated customer message and runbook changes.

dena: putting PR for runbook updates and preflight script, link in doc when ready.

ops_oncall: closing thread for now — move to postmortem channel once doc drafted. thanks everyone.
